Definition
[Elliptic, parabolic, and hyperbolic isometries] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0196 1. ch31:31.7\group Hyperbolic isometries

An orientation-preserving isometry is elliptic if it fixes a point of $\mathbb H^n$, parabolic if it fixes exactly one point at infinity and no interior point, and hyperbolic if it fixes exactly two points at infinity and no interior point.
